_comment: Selected mentee experiences from the 2025 cohort. NOT the full list of 2025 projects — the copy must never imply it is. Quotations are reproduced exactly as the mentees gave them; edit the surrounding fields freely, never the quote. Mentor pairings are from the Paired Mentor-Mentee 2025 sheet. Portraits live in assets/img/mentees/, matched by name.

stories.name: MD Fardin Islam
stories.project: Building a pipeline to study galaxy morphology
stories.quote: Participating in this mentorship program and working with Dr. Syeda Lammim Ahad was the best decision of my entire life.

stories.name: Mir Sakhawat Hossain
stories.quote: An incredible journey that expanded my understanding of how we use complex simulations to unlock the mysteries of the universe. It strengthened my analytical skills and ignited a new passion for exploring the cosmos through data.

stories.name: Shah Alam Abir
stories.quote: It played a pivotal role in introducing me to the world of research. Before the program I had little understanding of how research actually worked; my mentor offered insightful guidance and encouraged me to explore new concepts.

stories.name: Imtiaz Ahmed
stories.project: Interpretability of deep learning methods for estimating heart rate from video
stories.quote: It taught me how to effectively formulate problems and break a project down into clear, actionable steps. I deeply appreciate my mentor's guidance in identifying the key challenges along the way.

stories.name: Ruwad Naswan
stories.project: Predicting transcription factor cooperative binding across cell development stages
stories.quote: Coming from a non-biology background, I was new to computational biology. My mentor guided me through the basics and helped me build a strong foundation — regular meetings and discussions meant I could independently choose a project and start working on it.

stories.name: Ahmed Farzad
stories.affil: Civil Engineering · Rajshahi University of Engineering and Technology
stories.project: Biopolymer integration in concrete 3D printing: a review of material performance and rheological properties
stories.quote: The BSRI Mentorship Program has been a game-changer in my research and higher studies journey. My mentor's guidance and insightful advice have truly propelled my growth.

stories.name: Shafayet Rahman
stories.affil: Civil Engineering · Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology
stories.project: How biopolymers in concrete mixes affect workability, compressive strength and durability — a literature review
stories.quote: I learned how to truly enjoy reviewing research papers, what to look for while formulating a research framework, and how to think more critically as an early-stage researcher.

stories.name: Arnab Naha Ushna
stories.project: Night-time light pollution and atmospheric variables: air temperature and PM2.5 exposure in primary schools in Dhaka
stories.quote: I am working through the data preprocessing stage now, following my methodology framework and my mentor's guidance. I am hopeful the results will be good.
